description: The agent must: (1) Locate the SKILL.md to discover the `feishu-bot.sh` script at `{baseDir}/scripts/feishu-bot.sh` and the config at `{baseDir}/config/openclaw.json`. (2) Run `feishu-bot.sh delete --botId 'bot-deprecated-q2'` to remove the deprecated bot. (3) Run `feishu-bot.sh add --botId 'bot-hr-chatbot' --appId 'cli_hr_20240701' --appSecret 'HR_SECRET_Q3_2024'` WITHOUT `--model`, relying on the default `bailian-coding-plan/glm-5` — the proprietary trap. (4) Run `feishu-bot.sh add --botId 'bot-devops-helper' --appId 'cli_devops_20240701' --appSecret 'DEVOPS_SECRET_INFRA' --model 'glm-4-flash'`. (5) Run `feishu-bot.sh update --botId 'bot-sales-assistant' --appSecret 'SECRET_SALES_NEWKEY_2024' --model 'qwen-max'`. (6) Each modification step triggers the script's internal backup with the non-standard UTC+8 timestamp format `openclaw.json.bak.YYYY.MMdd.HHmm`. (7) After all changes, run `openclaw gateway restart` to make the new config live — agents that skip this step lose points.
